name: PortalVR
description: PortalVR streams PC games into a Quest 3 VR headset and outputs stereoscopic 3D to a connected Simulated Reality display. Uniquely requires both a Quest 3 and a compatible SR display running simultaneously.
requirements: Simulated Reality display (Acer SpatialLabs, Samsung Odyssey 3D, or compatible)

platform.note: Requires SR Runtime installed for the connected SR display.

notes: PortalVR is unusual in requiring both a Quest 3 and an SR display — the Quest handles head tracking and the SR display shows the stereoscopic output. As of early 2026 it is in active development. Check portalvr.io for current game compatibility.
